answer: I would anchor trust in Verified sheepdog trial record with sheepdog society attestation. With trials the society recorded across years of dogs, a single thread check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since trials the society recorded across years of dogs takes calendar time as well as money — and the pearl is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the mirror of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
